before.note: One run on the live corpus at the base sha (the benchmark's own tree, redrive read-only via a no-op cascade_terminal_sync; sentinels doctor-full and corpus-currency stubbed). Process time and spawns are the bar; wall_ms is attribution only. The redrive axis ran under peer load, so its process_ms is a ceiling of one run, not a floor. Memo figures (226 collector calls, ~156k _read_meta, 14.5s) were measured on a smaller corpus.
